documentation.rationale: VIN, itemized price breakdown, and an AutoCheck summary (clean title, 0 accidents, multiple owners) establish identity and deal terms. But the maintenance half is entirely absent: no cooling-system, subframe, VANOS, tire, or clutch records/receipts - only 'Excellent Condition' seller prose. This is the partial (one half only) band.

condition.rationale: Attached photos show clean paint, tidy leather interior, and no visible cosmetic defects, but nothing establishes mechanical condition: no fluid analysis, no cooling-system invoice, no subframe photos, no tire date codes. Nothing wrong is stated, but nothing specific is proven either.

price_value.rationale: Asking $26,999 all-in sits above the fair-value estimate's top end ($24,481, mid $21,222 from 37 mileage-adjusted sold comps). Low mileage alone does not justify the premium given the total absence of the documentation (cooling, subframe) that the market notes say matters more than mileage on this model.

mission_fit.rationale: As a future_keeper candidate, the manual S52 drivetrain and clean-title/low-accident profile are on-mission traits, but the price sits above fair value without the documentation that would justify a keeper premium, which cuts against cash-preservation discipline.

logistics.rationale: Tulsa, OK is a long distance from Carmel, CA requiring flight and drive-home. It is a large dealer group (Group 1), which typically permits third-party PPIs, but no PPI-access statement is given, so access is unconfirmed.

evidence.mission_note: Evaluated as a future_keeper, this car offers the on-mission manual S52 drivetrain and a desirable color combination, but its price sits above the fair-value range while lacking the cooling and subframe documentation the model's known weak points demand, which conflicts with a cash-preservation approach to a selective keeper purchase.
evidence.rationale: The listing and VIN decode establish a clean-title, 0-accident, low-mileage (36,362 mi) 2000 Z3 M Roadster with the S52 engine, which avoids the S54 rod-bearing/VANOS risk relevant to 2001-2002 cars. Identity and deal terms are verifiable (VIN, itemized price, AutoCheck summary), but no maintenance evidence is offered for either at-risk area named in the model's weak-point profile: no cooling-system receipts and no rear subframe/trunk-floor inspection or photos, despite these being the two items this model most needs documented regardless of mileage. Attached photos show a cosmetically clean car with no visible defects, but nothing photographed or stated proves mechanical soundness. The asking price of $26,999 all-in is above the top of the deterministic fair-value estimate ($17,724-$24,481, mid $21,222) drawn from 37 mileage-adjusted comps, so the low mileage is not currently offset by either price discipline or documentation. Distance from Carmel, CA to the Tulsa, OK dealer is a logistics factor rather than a risk, but PPI access is not addressed in the listing.
evidence.next_action: Request the full AutoCheck/Carfax report plus any cooling-system and subframe documentation from the dealer, and arrange a specialist BMW PPI (lift inspection of the rear subframe/differential mount and cooling system) before any funds move.
